title: Splitting two blocks of coordinates
statement: For any type $A$, there is a bijection from sign-valued functions on $\mathrm{Fin}(2)\times A$ to pairs of sign-valued functions on $A$. It restricts a function to the block with first coordinate $0$ and to the block with first coordinate $1$; the inverse combines the two blocks according to that first coordinate.
